content.short: Scalable Cardano NFT ranking platform providing analytics & rarities to keep up with market trends.
content.description:
OpenCNFT is a side project, the purpose of which is to provide data on trends such as traded volumes or wallet holders of CardanoNFT projects in an automated way. We want to provide an easy to use tool for the Cardano Community.

We track data from the leading marketplaces of the Cardano Community and directly from the blockchain (amount of minted assets, holders, total transactions, and more...)
